issues.issue: Whether the appellant can adduce new evidence in this appeal to support continuing the class action.
issues.applicant_position: Appellant seeks to adduce new evidence in this appeal.
issues.result_text: Motion to admit new evidence dismissed for failing Palmer criteria and fairness considerations.

issues.issue: Whether the Federal Court erred in law by applying issue estoppel and functus officio doctrines to deny remedial jurisdiction to reopen certification motion.
issues.applicant_position: Federal Court erred on issue estoppel conditions and discretion; remedial question on evidentiary deficiencies is new and not foreclosed.
issues.respondent_position: Issue estoppel applies; no error in Federal Court's analysis; no new remedial question; Rules 385 and 334.2 do not override issue estoppel.
issues.result_text: No error in issue estoppel application or Federal Court's legal conclusions.

issues.issue: Whether the Federal Court erred in failing to exercise discretion to set aside issue estoppel and allow reargument of certification motion.
issues.applicant_position: Federal Court erred in failing to exercise discretion to set aside issue estoppel.
issues.respondent_position: Federal Court properly exercised discretion considering appeal, new evidence, and finality importance.
issues.result_text: No palpable error in discretion exercise; finality doctrine must be preserved.
